title: Paediatric pulmonary hypertension and heart failure: pressures and pumps
refs: American Heart Association pulmonary hypertension guidance
European Society of Cardiology pulmonary guidance

steps.tx: **Pulmonary hypertension** in children means mean pulmonary arterial pressure above 20 mm mercury on right heart catheterisation. Pulmonary vascular resistance above 3 Wood units separates precapillary disease from left heart congestion. Echocardiogram suggests pressure through tricuspid regurgitation velocity before catheterisation.
steps.say: Pulmonary hypertension in children means mean pulmonary arterial pressure above 20 millimetres of mercury on right heart catheterisation. Vascular resistance above 3 Wood units separates precapillary disease from left heart congestion. Echocardiogram suggests pressure through regurgitation velocity before catheterisation.

steps.tx: **Classification** groups disease into idiopathic, congenital heart disease, lung disease, thrombotic and multifactorial patterns for children. Pulmonary hypertension with congenital heart disease often reflects septal defects with pulmonary overcirculation and shear stress. Lung disease with hypoxia drives resistance through vasoconstriction and vascular remodelling over time.

Hypertension with congenital heart disease often reflects septal defects with pulmonary overcirculation. Lung disease with hypoxia drives resistance through vasoconstriction and remodelling.

steps.tx: **Eisenmenger syndrome** develops when chronic left to right shunt remodels pulmonary vessels beyond repair in childhood. Right to left shunting then causes cyanosis with polycythaemia and clubbing as defects reverse. Vasodilator challenge on catheterisation tests reversibility before defect closure is considered for surgery.

steps.tx: **Targeted therapy** uses prostacyclin analogues, endothelin blockers and phosphodiesterase inhibitors by severity and risk class. Sildenafil and bosentan provide oral options for moderate disease in children with stable haemodynamics. Intravenous prostacyclin suits severe disease with right ventricular failure and poor functional class needing hospital care.
steps.say: Targeted therapy uses prostacyclin analogues, endothelin blockers and phosphodiesterase inhibitors by severity. Sildenafil and bosentan provide oral options for moderate disease in children. Intravenous prostacyclin suits severe disease with right ventricular failure.

steps.tx: **Bosentan hepatotoxicity** needs monthly liver monitoring with dose limits in most children receiving therapy. Sildenafil dosing adjusts by weight and avoids nitrate combinations that drop systemic pressure dangerously. Prostacyclin needs continuous infusion care because rebound and infection risks are real in long term use.
steps.say: Bosentan hepatotoxicity needs monthly liver monitoring with dose limits in most children. Sildenafil dosing adjusts by weight and avoids nitrate combinations that drop systemic pressure. Prostacyclin needs continuous infusion care because rebound and infection risks are real.

steps.tx: **Heart failure** in infants causes tachypnoea, poor weight gain and hepatomegaly from volume overload and low output. Diuretics relieve congestion while digoxin improves contractility in systolic failure with reduced squeeze. Ventricular septal defect and coeliac disease can both present with similar failure patterns requiring echo.

steps.tx: **Diuretic strategy** starts with furosemide for congestive symptoms, then adds afterload reduction once stable and euvolaemic. Captopril reduces systemic resistance in left to right shunts with failure and improves symptoms. Fluid and salt restriction complement drug therapy during decompensation with daily weights.

steps.tx: **Right heart failure** from hypertension shows hepatomegaly, ascites and peripheral oedema with low output in children. Diuretic care must preserve cardiac output because overdiuresis collapses preload and worsens fatigue. Pulmonary vasodilators improve right ventricular afterload once congestion is controlled carefully.

steps.tx: **Prognosis** worsens with raised resistance, falling cardiac index and functional class deterioration over years. Six minute walk distance tracks response to targeted therapy in older children with regular testing. Eisenmenger physiology carries poor survival once cyanosis and polycythaemia dominate the clinical picture.

steps.tx: **Final table** locks pressure cutoff, resistance cutoff, catheter as gold standard, and drugs by class: sildenafil and bosentan orally, prostacyclin for severe disease, furosemide for congestion and captopril for afterload. Avoid nitrates with sildenafil and watch liver tests with bosentan.

Sildenafil and bosentan serve orally, prostacyclin suits severe disease, furosemide helps congestion and captopril reduces afterload. Avoid nitrates with sildenafil and watch liver tests with bosentan.
